mentions.name: Gaming Couch JS SDK
mentions.description: JavaScript SDK for building multiplayer party games for the Gaming Couch platform, with three.js used for the 3D world. It is planned for launch to third-party developers so anyone can build and ship a simple, fun multiplayer party game for the platform, ideally in a single weekend; the Pop It: Desert Island mini-game doubled as a test drive of the SDK.
mentions.audience: game devs, or those aspiring to be one, who want to develop and ship their own party game
mentions.source_excerpt: The whole game is built in JavaScript (three.js for the 3D world) using a JS SDK I've been working on. It doubled as a test drive of the same SDK I want to launch for third-party developers, so anyone can build and ship a simple, fun multiplayer party game for the platform, ideally in a single weekend.
